children: Returning partnership reflects confidence in FirstService Residential's operational expertise and hospitality-driven approach

ATLANTA, Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstService Residential, North America's leading residential property management company, has been selected to provide full-service management services for Spire Midtown, a premier high-rise condominium community located in the heart of Midtown Atlanta.

The partnership marks a return for the iconic 391-unit community, which previously partnered with FirstService Residential. Spire Midtown is recognized for its distinctive presence along Atlanta's skyline and its vibrant urban location on Peachtree Street, offering residents access to world-class dining, entertainment, cultural attractions and some of the city's most sought-after amenities.

Under the new management agreement, FirstService Residential will provide comprehensive management, maintenance and concierge services. The community features an extensive amenity package that includes a clubroom, fitness center, yoga space, theater room, outdoor pool, garden terrace, and business center.

"We are honored to welcome Spire Midtown back to FirstService Residential," said Gabrielle Leary, vice president at FirstService Residential. "What ultimately made the difference with Spire was our ability to connect operational excellence with a true hospitality mindset. From staffing and training to financial oversight and vendor management, we demonstrated how we could bring immediate stability while elevating the overall resident experience. The Board saw that we don't just manage buildings, we strengthen them."

As Atlanta's high-rise communities continue to evolve, boards are increasingly seeking management partners that can balance financial stewardship, operational consistency and elevated resident experiences. FirstService Residential's high-rise expertise, local market knowledge and resident-focused service model position the company to help communities like Spire protect property values while enhancing daily living for residents.

FirstService Residential manages communities of every type and size throughout Georgia, including condominium associations, homeowner associations, lifestyle communities and high-rise properties. The company's local experts provide property management solutions tailored to the unique needs of each community, supported by the resources and best practices of North America's property management leader.

FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.

Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community's specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.
Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.
